findings.problem: «موٹا وقت» ('fat/thick time') is a literal calque of 'coarser'; with «باریک وقت» the pair reads oddly. These name zoom levels of the timeline.
findings.suggested: بڑا وقفہ (zoom_in: چھوٹا وقفہ) — or زوم آؤٹ / زوم ان, matching tui.projects.zoom «زوم»

findings.problem: «زیرِ نگرانی» is the glossary's rendering of 'supervised' (systemd units, glossary §2) and the ur 'monitor' family is «نگرانی»; using it for projects 'tracked' collides with both.
